evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Design, implement, and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and reporting solutions for data quality
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by a full Data Quality Management section covering profiling, monitoring, alerting, and asset certification, with no velocity/speed language, driving a rigour classification.
evidence.domain_risk: Define the approach and rules for data and dashboard asset certification. Conduct ongoing certification of critical data assets based on agreed-upon methodologies
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role certifies critical data assets and manages data quality monitoring, but there is no explicit financial reporting/regulatory/compliance language, keeping it at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Provide ongoing support and maintenance for existing data quality rules and monitoring solutions
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role maintains and extends existing data quality rules, monitoring solutions, and certification methodologies within a large consultancy delivery team, indicating a mature, established function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Interact with various database systems to extract, load, and transform data
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities are organized into precise named sections (Code Development and Deployment, Data Quality Management, Data Engineering and Automation) with concrete tasks, letting the reader understand the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Provide ongoing support and maintenance for existing data quality rules and monitoring solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's output is entirely internal data infrastructure (pipelines, data quality monitoring, asset certification) rather than serving a specific commercial, product, or finance team.
evidence.autonomy_level: Collaborate with stakeholders to define data quality monitoring rules and ensure alignment
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities focus on developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining scoped solutions rather than setting overall direction, placing this at execution level.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools for the candidate's own workflow or of building AI-consuming data infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation. Provide support for user testing, troubleshoot issues, and implement necessary fixes
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and data quality monitoring are named as owned responsibilities with explicit ownership verbs ('Design, implement, and maintain', 'Create and maintain'), not just listed tools.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Design, implement, and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and reporting solutions for data quality
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality monitoring and asset certification are named concerns but framed as delivery/maintenance tasks rather than dominating a compliance/trust risk register, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Provide ongoing support and maintenance for existing data quality rules and monitoring solutions
